|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Acclamator-Class Assault Ship (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-acclamatorclassassau022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/acclamatorclassassaultship.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/acclamatorclassassaultship.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Adds 1 to attrition against opponent here for each piloted [Republic] starship present here. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Concussion Missiles may deploy aboard.”

Text: “May add 4 pilots, 4 passengers, and 4 vehicles. Adds 1 to attrition against opponent here for each piloted [Republic] starship present here. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.
